transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, after 1 week. Try to avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you, that's helpful to know. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thank you. I'm also wondering, I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended: Some sensitivity to light can be normal as your eyes adjust, and if things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside can help. But strong pain in bright light, or very bad light sensitivity with a red, painful eye, is not normal and should be checked. Do you have any other questions?
